analysis:
This pass examined two head-side excerpts of docs/threat-model.yaml, lines 473-1395. The only changed range visible in these units is the new TB-012 entry at head lines 811-841, which documents the provider_to_local_addon_hold_socket boundary. The other changes in this file are at head 43-45 (header note), 232-241 (new A-018 asset) and 2305-2337 (presumably T-059), and they fall outside these units.

TB-012 documents the following behavior:
- The socket is ~/.darkbloom/runtime/addon.sock, mode 0600 inside a 0700 directory, and a live socket is never replaced.
- Each request is checked by LOCAL_PEERTOKEN audit token, effective UID, and a Developer ID requirement for io.darkbloom.sandbox under team SLDQ2GJ6TL with hardened runtime.
- DEBUG builds may add one configured identity.
- A hold closes admission, finishes accepted work within 120 seconds and unloads models. It does not send the provider_drain barrier or stop the App Attest worker.
- Leases last 30-600 seconds, and expiry is gated on ownership.lock. Active holds persist with mode 0600.

Limitations at lines 833-841 state the following:
- Same-UID code can tamper with the hold or lock files, or stop the provider.
- Add-on entitlements beyond the hardened runtime are not inspected.
- Leases use wall-clock time.

This is documentation only; no provider source code is in these units. The new surface is availability (A-018) and does not touch prompt confidentiality (A-001), keys (A-003), or authorization (A-016, TB-011). The hold does not touch App Attest proofs or grants per line 829. No regression was identified in the documentation itself.

Open questions for integration, all requiring the actual source in provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Addon/:
- Whether the DEBUG identity is compiled out of release builds.
- Whether the peer check is done by audit token rather than by PID, to avoid a PID race.
- Whether a stale persisted hold record could deny service indefinitely.
- Whether the coordinator handles the busy/draining status, which the header defers to platform work.

Unchanged retained TB-007, TB-009, TB-010, TB-011 and T-007 through T-041 text in these units was not re-verified.
